overviewParagraphs: Located just outside Phnom Penh, Chhun On Golf Resort is an impressive 36-hole golfing sanctuary that features two highly contrasting and world-class championship courses: the Lakes Course and the Palm Course.

The Lakes Course, designed by renowned architect Brian Curley, is a visual masterpiece characterized by expansive water hazards that come into play on almost every hole. The strategic placement of water demands precision and shot-making skills, while the beautifully contoured fairways and platinum paspalum greens offer a truly rewarding experience.

The Palm Course offers a distinctly different, classic parkland feel. Framed by hundreds of indigenous palm trees, the layout challenges golfers with its mature, natural setting, requiring careful positioning off the tee and strategic navigation to the well-protected greens.
Both courses are complemented by first-class resort amenities, making Chhun On a must-play destination on any luxury Cambodian golf tour.

curatorBriefHtml: Chhun On Golf Resort is a premier Par 72 / 72 championship layout in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, crafted by Brian Curley (Lakes) / Traditional (Palm) (2023) and stretching to 6,200 Yards (Blue Tees) across a lakeside / parkland environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its dramatic island green & water sculpting (Thrilling signature target) and flawless modern zoysia conditioning (Lush, tight lie surfaces).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Chhun On Golf Resort (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Cambodia dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie service & etiquette (Attentive yardage help), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Phnom Penh golf tour by AGS, Chhun On Golf Resort provides a distinct architectural test by Brian Curley (Lakes) / Traditional (Palm) that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Chhun On Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Chhun On Golf Resort in Phnom Penh, Cambodia is a Par 72 / 72 championship layout designed by Brian Curley (Lakes) / Traditional (Palm) (opened 2023), measuring 6,200 Yards (Blue Tees) within a lakeside / parkland setting. It is particularly noted for dramatic island green & water sculpting (Thrilling signature target).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Chhun On Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Chhun On Golf Resort operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie service & etiquette (Attentive yardage help)), and private VIP transfers from your Phnom Penh hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Chhun On Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Chhun On Golf Resort's flawless modern zoysia conditioning (Lush, tight lie surfaces) alongside dramatic island green & water sculpting (Thrilling signature target). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Chhun On Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Peak playing conditions at Chhun On Golf Resort in Phnom Penh typically run during the cooler, drier months from November through April, with early morning tee times recommended year-round.
